items.title: Pierre Boussaguet interviewed by Matthieu Jaffre, Aix en Provence, France, July 28, 2020
items.q: There is one tune great, it’s written I think by Louie Bellson. And you can hear Louie Bellson telling the chords before the bridge: B flat, A flat.
